alerts.description: From monday morning until tuesday forenoon, heavy rainfall is expected, locally 50-80 mm in 24 hours in lower areas.
alerts.instruction: Flooding will occur: Clear drains and gutters so water can flow away. Difficult driving conditions: Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk. Adjust your speed and drive according to the conditions. Consider if travel is necessary. Some places may lose road access: Follow advice from local emergency authorities. Flooding and landslides: Check warnings at Varsom.no.

alerts.title: Strong wind gusts, yellow level, Troms and northern parts of Nordland, 2026-10-19T04:00:00+00:00, 2026-10-19T19:00:00+00:00
alerts.area: Troms and northern parts of Nordland
alerts.description: Locally strong wind gusts around 27-33 m/s are expected from southwest, and storm force 10 at the coast. The wind will decrease first in the south Monday afternoon and later in the north Monday evening.
alerts.instruction: Secure loose objects: Consider taking precautions to prevent damage before the event occurs. Avoid unnecessary travel in exposed areas. Risk of traffic obstructions: Check road reports on vegvesen.no/trafikk. Risk of cancelled departures: Follow advice and check the status from transport operators. High waves hitting land: Be cautious when moving in the coastal zone.
